responsibility: Implements construction of SSA form and incremental SSA updating for GIMPLE. It collects definition/use sites for symbols and existing SSA names, computes liveness and dominance-frontier-based PHI placement, tracks current reaching definitions, renames statements and PHIs by dominator walk, manages replacement mappings and deferred name release, and provides the update_ssa machinery that transformation passes use after CFG or statement rewrites to restore valid scalar and virtual SSA webs.
same_name_distinction: Implements the SSA construction and incremental update algorithms declared in gcc/tree-into-ssa.h. Unlike the header’s exported update_ssa/create_new_def_for interface, this file performs PHI placement, liveness and dominance analysis, current-definition tracking, and dominator-walk renaming.
